attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his newsletter.

semantics.note: The 'completely failed' clause is a firm observation. The 'appears to be going nowhere fast' clause is hedged and correctly kept as a qualifier. 'This software' means generative AI, centred on ChatGPT.

contract.note: Measuring adoption by substantial repeated use is a fair, ordinary reading of 'completely failed'. It neither requires majority adoption nor turns on profit.

evidence.note: Dated 2025-02-20, inside the target period. Reports 400M weekly ChatGPT users. This is a company figure from OpenAI's COO, reported by reputable press, not independent measurement.

reviews.rationale: Days before publication, OpenAI reported 400M weekly ChatGPT users, up 33% since December. Even as a company disclosure, that scale of repeated use contradicts a complete failure of consumer adoption. The hedged stagnation clause is not scored.
